abe_solid_kappah_floor_0.rationale: Active-solid Arrhenius state set: s_init=2500 J/kg/K, kappah_floor=0, viscosity_solid=1e18 Pa s, yield_stress_c=1e7 Pa. Exercises Arrhenius homologous strengthening across all 100 states (min rel RHS on vs off = 8.60e-3), while F_conv < 0.5 F_tot in Pass 1 so has_lid=False and n_nodes(eta_eff != eta_diff) = 0.

abe_solid_yield_active.rationale: Yield-active lid state set on the SPIDER EOS table: sub-rheological-transition interior (s_init=2150 J/kg/K, s_bot in [1950, 2150], delta_s in [1620, 1820], s_surf=330 < S_sol(0)=455.17 J/kg/K) with kappah_floor=0, viscosity_solid=3e17 Pa s, and yield_stress_c=150 Pa (yield_stress_mu=0). Pass 1 interior convection exceeds conduction (f_conv > 0.5) beneath a cold sub-solidus conductive upper boundary layer (has_lid=True in all 100 states), generating convective driving stress tau_d_lid >> tau_y_lid = 150 Pa so plastic yielding acts in 9..13 nodes across all 100/100 states and changes the RHS relative to yield-off (tau_y -> infinity) by 2.331e-4..7.270e-4 (>= 1e-4 in all 100 states) while keeping NumPy vs JAX relative RHS difference <= 1.944e-7 <= 1e-6 (and <= 6.105e-16 with harmonised alpha).

abe_solid_default.rationale: Default inert-path state set: s_init=2900 J/kg/K, kappah_floor=10 m^2/s, viscosity_solid=1e21 Pa s. kappah_floor=10 clamps eddy diffusivity in both Pass 1 and Pass 2 so RHS on == RHS off in all 100 states.

flux_vs_rhs_diagnostic.explanation: Both max_rel_flux_numpy_vs_jax = 6.401861e-7 and max_rel_rhs_numpy_vs_jax = 2.038391e-14 occur at state index 4, basic node k = 64 (staggered cell ks = 63, P = 15.32 GPa, S = 2348.11 J kg^-1 K^-1). All rheology outputs (eta_diff, eta_eff = 2.070761e24 Pa s), T, rho, Cp, and conductive flux J_cond agree to 0.0 between NumPy and JAX. The sole difference is single-phase thermal expansivity alpha: NumPy interpolates the thermal_exp_solid table directly (3.097833e-5 K^-1) whereas JAX evaluates the thermodynamic identity dTdPs * rho * Cp / T from four interpolated tables (3.098272e-5 K^-1, rel diff 1.415588e-4). Because kappa_h is linear in alpha, J_conv[64] shifts by 4.320324e-9 W m^-2. The diagnostic flux ratio divides by the maximum interior flux max(|J_tot[1:-1]|) = 6.748543e-3 W m^-2 (excluding the surface radiative boundary node k = 99 at 6.219041e4 W m^-2), giving 6.401861e-7, whereas the RHS ratio divides the resulting flux-divergence difference at cell 63 (1.147075e-12 J kg^-1 K^-1 yr^-1) by the global RHS norm max(|dS/dt|) = 56.273547 J kg^-1 K^-1 yr^-1 at the surface-cooled top cell ks = 98, giving 2.038391e-14.

six_row_call_count_table.reason: Solidus temperature T_sol(P) is cached on basic nodes during phase evaluation and reused without extra EOS table lookups.
In lid mode: 1 vector call on N_b basic nodes in phase evaluation plus 1 scalar call at (T_i, P_i) inside _compute_stagnant_lid_state_core (+2). In local mode: 1 vector call on N_b basic nodes (+1).
In lid mode: 1 vector call on N_b basic nodes in phase evaluation plus 1 scalar call at P_lid_base inside _compute_stagnant_lid_state_core (+2). In local mode: 1 vector call on N_b basic nodes (+1).
In lid mode: 1 call per RHS between Pass 1 and Pass 2 (+1). In local mode: only active when stress_closure_mode == "lid" (+0).
1 vector call on N_b basic nodes in Pass 2 (+1 in both lid and local modes).

Relative to rheology.enabled=False (0 calls), Pass 1 (theta=None) and Pass 2 (theta=lid_state["theta"] in lid mode, None in local mode) each invoke _viscous_mixing_length_factor_core once, giving +2 calls per RHS in both NumPy and JAX.
